name: P-009 / R-19 live dependency-graph resolver timing against the pane deadline (event-wait-settlement-2026-10-20)
summary: The R-19 probe (docs/evidence/ews-p009-r19-latency-live/time.mts) timed the dependency-graph resolvers 5 times on the papercusp harness against papercusp@5432. Before the wait leg (depEdges alone) the slowest run took 232.9 ms; with it (depEdges and depWaits concurrently, as the pane loads them) 387.9 ms; depWaits alone 411.1 ms. The deadline is 10000 ms (RESOLVER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS). The committed oracle judged it PASS. 6 of 6 negative controls failed on exactly their targeted assertion.

assertions.evidence: the probe read papercusp@5432; the operator connection string (papercup-dev-api.service) names papercusp@5432
depWaits rows per run: 1450,1450,1450,1450,1450; depWaits alone ms per run: 411.1,347.9,310.2,328.8,290.8
depEdges alone ms per run (the pane's load before the wait leg): 166,192.9,232.9,218.7,186.7
max depEdges alone 232.9 ms, max depEdges+depWaits 387.9 ms, max depWaits alone 411.1 ms; deadline 10000 ms (RESOLVER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS)
the control corrupts one property of the real measurement and must fail exactly within-deadline; the oracle failed within-deadline
the control corrupts one property of the real measurement and must fail exactly operator-db; the oracle failed operator-db
the control corrupts one property of the real measurement and must fail exactly min-runs; the oracle failed min-runs
the control corrupts one property of the real measurement and must fail exactly graph-non-empty; the oracle failed graph-non-empty
the control corrupts one property of the real measurement and must fail exactly wait-leg-ran; the oracle failed wait-leg-ran
the control corrupts one property of the real measurement and must fail exactly before-recorded; the oracle failed before-recorded

environment.reader: docs/evidence/ews-p009-r19-latency-live/time.mts through npx tsx, in-process resolver calls

measurement.deadlineSource: RESOLVER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS in packages/operator-core/lib/sync-resolver/read-deadline.ts, read by the probe

beforeAfter.beforeMeans: workItems.depEdges alone: what the Work-tab dependency graph pane loaded before the wait leg
beforeAfter.afterMeans: workItems.depEdges and workItems.depWaits concurrently: what the pane loads now

instrument.role: Every pass/fail decision on the measurement is taken by this committed oracle; run.mjs only runs the probe, applies the controls and records output. The oracle test also pins the bar deadline to RESOLVER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS.

limitations: Timed in-process against the live operator database with the tree's resolver source. This is the resolver the bar names; the HTTP round trip and the webview render are not part of the timing.
Wall-clock times on a shared dev box under live fleet load vary between runs; the receipt records the observed maxima over the runs, not an upper bound.
The bound on the wait leg query count is the integration test bound to the same clause (dependency-graph-edges.integration.test.ts), not this receipt.
